shared_context.context: Synthetic plant-maintenance example; no real site, person, supplier or equipment.
shared_context.source_handling: Treat each supplied record as an authentic record of its stated issuer; examine scope and preserve qualifications.

reading_blocks.text: The calibrated logger recorded coolant temperature 82 C for pump A4 at 14:00 UTC on 4 April 2026.
Visual inspection, alignment check and vibration reading completed on pump A4 on 10 April 2026. Vibration 2.1 mm/s RMS at the drive end. Pressure test not recorded on this form.
Signed by the contractor site lead on 10 April 2026. Client witness signature: blank.

Before a pump returns to service after an overhaul, the inspection record must show a completed visual inspection, alignment check, vibration reading below 2.8 mm/s RMS, and a pressure test at 1.5 times working pressure, each witnessed by a client representative.
A step may be waived only in writing by the area engineering manager, with the waiver attached to the inspection record.
Order 4471 for one mechanical seal, type MS-40, acknowledged on 8 April 2026. Requested delivery date 15 April 2026. Estimated dispatch from stock within 5 working days, subject to availability.

action_context: Release pump A4 to service on 13 April 2026 after its overhaul.

premises.question: Does the supplied logger record a coolant temperature of 82 C for pump A4 at 14:00 on 4 April 2026?
premises.intended_use: A scoped epistemic finding about one located reading; the caller decides what follows.

requirements: Use the located record at its stated scope.

stakes.basis: A wrong reading would be re-checked at the next walk-down; it does not gate the release by itself.

premises.question: Does the post-overhaul inspection record for pump A4 satisfy the return-to-service requirements of procedure RTS-7 section 4?
premises.intended_use: A scoped epistemic finding comparing a record with a procedure; the release decision belongs to the caller.

requirements: Apply the current version of the procedure to the located inspection record.
Treat an unrecorded step as unrecorded, not as failed or passed.

stakes.basis: Releasing on an unsatisfied inspection is a safety exposure and a procedure breach.

premises.question: Did the area engineering manager waive the pressure-test step for pump A4?
premises.intended_use: A scoped epistemic finding; a verbal waiver is not a recorded one.

requirements: Only a located written waiver attached to the inspection record counts under RTS-7 section 6.

stakes.basis: Without a valid waiver the missing pressure test blocks the release.

premises.question: Will the supplier deliver the replacement mechanical seal for pump A4 by 15 April 2026?
premises.intended_use: A scoped epistemic finding about a supplier's commitment; scheduling belongs to the caller.

requirements: Distinguish an acknowledged request from a committed delivery date.

stakes.basis: A late seal delays the release by days; it does not create a safety exposure.
